title: A knowledge base and documentation another technician can follow

videos.script: A knowledge base is where a support team keeps what it has learnt: how to set something up, what an error means, how a known problem was solved. {{keeps}} It is only worth something if the next person can find the right article and follow it without the author in the room. {{worth}} In this lesson an old article turns out to be the cause of lesson 1's fault. You find it, follow it, watch it fail, and rewrite it so that it cannot fail the same way. {{old}} And you look at what makes an article findable, which matters as much as what it says. {{findable}}
